% CVPR-format version of paper/main.tex (the ICLR 2027 manuscript).
% Built on the official CVPR author kit (github.com/cvpr-org/author-kit, CVPR 2026 release --
% the newest published; swap cvpr.sty when the 2027 kit appears and re-check the CFP).
%
% body.tex and supp.tex are GENERATED from paper/main.tex by paper_cvpr/convert.py -- edit the
% ICLR source and rerun the script, never the generated files. The tables and figure are \input
% directly from paper/tables and paper/figures, so numbers regenerated by
% experiments/make_iclr_tables.py flow into both versions automatically.
%
% ANONYMITY: keep the [review] option for submission. The author block below is the anonymous
% placeholder the review mode prints anyway; restore real authors only for camera-ready.
%
% Build: python convert.py && pdflatex main && bibtex main && pdflatex main && pdflatex main
% The supplementary is compiled after the references (author-kit convention) so it can
% cross-reference the main paper; split the PDF at the "Supplementary Material" page to submit.

\documentclass[10pt,twocolumn,letterpaper]{article}

\usepackage[review]{cvpr}      % REVIEW version (anonymous, line numbers)
% \usepackage{cvpr}            % CAMERA-READY version
% \usepackage[pagenumbers]{cvpr} % arXiv version
